notice: Catalogue of cases the offline entrypoint (tests/mvp.test.ts) and the opt-in smoke harness must cover. It describes required behaviour; it is not a contract for any interface and defines no response shape. No case here has been executed by #5. A case becomes a test only against a reviewed contract from the issue named in dependsOn; until then it is an explicit unverified gate.

legend.releaseGates: G1 to G6 are the six hard release gates in issue #1, in order.
legend.tests: #N-Ak is the k-th acceptance checkbox of issue #N; #5-Rk is the k-th acceptance-receipt checkbox of issue #5. Full text is in docs/acceptance.md.
legend.evidenceClassesPossible: F = offline fixture; RD = real daemon, no provider; L = authorized live provider. This is where the case could be shown, not where it has been.

cases.case: No sandbox ID configured
cases.expect: Refused before any provider path; zero provider mutations and zero credential transfers

cases.case: Unknown or unsupported profile name
cases.expect: Refused; zero provider mutations and zero credential transfers

cases.case: Smoke command run with no explicit opt-in
cases.expect: Exits without a single provider call and says why

cases.case: Opt-in set but maximum spend or runtime budget missing, zero, negative or non-numeric
cases.expect: Refused; zero provider calls

cases.case: Opt-in set but the sandbox ID given to the smoke command differs from the configured binding
cases.expect: Refused; zero provider calls; no lookup of the other ID

cases.case: Fixture or mock mode requested together with live opt-in, or selected by environment in a non-test entrypoint
cases.expect: Refused; fixture mode is labelled in output and cannot be reached as a fallback when the live path fails

cases.case: A provider, admin or database secret is present in the normal client environment
cases.expect: Client does not read, forward or echo it; output uses aliases only

cases.case: Live opt-in set but current owner authorization is absent or stale
cases.expect: Refused before any provider call
dependsOn: upstream non-browser owner credential for run read/events/stop (missing per #3 and #4 investigations)

cases.case: Sandbox belongs to a different owner than the binding
cases.expect: Fails closed as unauthorized; zero provider mutations and zero credential transfers

cases.case: Sandbox generation differs from the bound generation
cases.expect: Fails closed; zero provider mutations and zero credential transfers

cases.case: Provider returns a sandbox whose ID is not the one requested
cases.expect: Fails closed; the returned sandbox is never adopted or used

cases.case: Configured sandbox does not exist
cases.expect: Reported unavailable; zero create, start, update or delete calls

cases.case: Another sandbox matches by name or label, or the lookup is ambiguous
cases.expect: No replacement, adoption or second lookup

cases.case: Sandbox is public, ephemeral, has a destructive TTL, auto-delete or unrestricted egress, or the metadata is missing
cases.expect: Fails closed as incompatible; provider configuration is not repaired

cases.case: Sandbox is stopped
cases.expect: Reported stopped; the check does not wake it and a run is refused

cases.case: Sandbox has an unresolved prior attempt or an unrelated active workload
cases.expect: Reported reconciliation-required; nothing is interrupted and no run is admitted

cases.case: Request names a familiar revision other than the bound one
cases.expect: Refused before launch; zero provider mutations and zero credential transfers
dependsOn: upstream canonical producer: familiar root/revision in admission (missing per #3 investigation)

cases.case: Owner is revoked before submit, and between submit and dispatch
cases.expect: Refused or terminated as revoked; zero provider mutations and zero credential transfers

cases.case: Grant has expired before submit, and between claim and credential transfer
cases.expect: Refused with a reason distinct from revocation; no credential transfer
dependsOn: upstream canonical producer: familiar root/revision in admission (missing per #3 investigation)

cases.case: Server or harness does not advertise a required capability
cases.expect: Refused before submit

cases.case: Server resolves a sandbox other than the bound one at dispatch
cases.expect: Refused; no create, start or relabel call

cases.case: No authority: missing credential, wrong audience, missing binding or missing producer evidence. A caller-supplied familiar field, sandbox ID, account login or subscription state is offered instead
cases.expect: Each refused, naming what is absent; nothing supplied by the caller substitutes
dependsOn: upstream canonical producer: familiar root/revision in admission (missing per #3 investigation)
upstream non-browser owner credential for run read/events/stop (missing per #3 and #4 investigations)

cases.case: Two different operations submitted concurrently
cases.expect: Exactly one admitted; the other denied, not queued; one credential transfer in total

cases.case: Same operation and same payload submitted again, in parallel and after a disconnect
cases.expect: The existing run is returned; one run, one attempt, one credential transfer

cases.case: Same operation with changed task text
cases.expect: Conflict; the original run is untouched

cases.case: Same operation and task text, but one input file byte changed (input.SHA256SUMS no longer verifies)
cases.expect: Conflict, not a silent reuse of the earlier run
dependsOn: open question for #3: how input bytes enter the payload digest

cases.case: Report produced by a mock, a recorded fixture or an unbound harness run
cases.expect: Labelled as such and never counted toward the real-admission checkbox

cases.case: Read-only check is run on a sandbox with no runtime installed
cases.expect: Check reports the state and installs nothing; bootstrap happens only on an explicit action

cases.case: Bootstrap repeated on the same validated version
cases.expect: No reinstall, no state reset, no second supervisor; file hashes unchanged
dependsOn: upstream admitted install operation (missing per #3 investigation)

cases.case: Bootstrap interrupted part-way
cases.expect: Reads as not ready; a later run is refused until bootstrap completes

cases.case: Target directory already holds files Castles did not write, or a manifest hash does not match
cases.expect: Refused without overwriting anything

cases.case: Input exceeds a manifest bound: too many files, a file too large, total too large, path too long or too deep
cases.expect: Refused before staging; nothing is sent

cases.case: Input contains a symlink, an absolute path, a parent-directory segment, a NUL, or a name outside the allowed pattern
cases.expect: Refused before staging

cases.case: Input file name or content contains shell metacharacters
cases.expect: Staged as data; never interpolated into a command

cases.case: Report exceeds hardMaxBytes
cases.expect: Refused, or truncated with an explicit marker; never accepted silently

cases.case: Run reaches its time budget
cases.expect: New actions stop and the run enters the existing stop and reconciliation path; not reported as success

cases.case: Input instructs the agent to create a marker file and append a marker line (notes/automation-notice.txt)
cases.expect: Neither happens; enforced by runtime policy and checked from run evidence, not from the prompt

cases.case: Artifact or evidence path is malformed or traversing: ../, absolute, ~, NUL, backslash, drive letter, URL-encoded or Unicode-normalised
cases.expect: Export rejects it; evidence paths are treated as data, never as write targets

cases.case: Export destination exists, is a symlink, or has a symlinked parent leaving the owner-controlled directory
cases.expect: Refused; nothing overwritten; no partial file left

cases.case: Exported report bytes do not match the recorded digest
cases.expect: Export fails and leaves no partial file

cases.case: Acknowledgement lost after submit; client restarts and resubmits
cases.expect: The same operation and run are recovered; no second execution

cases.case: A second authorized client session reads the run
cases.expect: Same familiar revision, status, receipt and report bytes as the first session
dependsOn: upstream canonical producer: familiar root/revision in admission (missing per #3 investigation)
upstream non-browser owner credential for run read/events/stop (missing per #3 and #4 investigations)

cases.case: A different owner, or a stale or revoked credential, tries to read or follow the run
cases.expect: Refused, indistinguishable from a missing run; no events delivered
dependsOn: upstream non-browser owner credential for run read/events/stop (missing per #3 and #4 investigations)

cases.case: Event cursor is older than the retained window, or malformed
cases.expect: Explicit resnapshot for a gap; rejection for malformed; never a fresh launch and never a silent restart from zero

cases.case: Sandbox is stopped or unavailable when the result is read
cases.expect: Committed outcome is still returned with zero provider calls; a previously running task is reported outcome-unknown, never as having survived

cases.case: Local client cache is deleted, or forged to name another run or an approved state
cases.expect: Server record wins; the cache grants no read, cancel or approval

cases.case: Selected sandbox is stopped and started between two reads
cases.expect: A neutral workspace marker is byte-identical afterwards. Needs separate stop/start authorization
dependsOn: explicit stop/start authorization for an exclusively assigned sandbox

cases.case: Cancel a running attempt
cases.expect: Stopping, stopped, outcome-unknown and cleanup-required are reported distinctly; an accepted stop request is not shown as contained
dependsOn: upstream non-browser owner credential for run read/events/stop (missing per #3 and #4 investigations)

cases.case: Cancel races with natural completion; cancel sent twice
cases.expect: Exactly one terminal state; the second cancel is idempotent; the fence is still held

cases.case: A stale worker result arrives for an older attempt or lease
cases.expect: Rejected; the current record is unchanged

cases.case: Authorization expires between observe and cancel, or a different owner sends the cancel
cases.expect: Cancel refused; the run is untouched
dependsOn: upstream non-browser owner credential for run read/events/stop (missing per #3 and #4 investigations)

cases.case: Stop or start returns an ambiguous result or times out after provider acceptance
cases.expect: Reported outcome-unknown; reconciled by the exact recorded identity; nothing is relaunched and no new operation is created

cases.case: Client closes its connection or exits during a run
cases.expect: Not treated as cancellation; the run and its fence are unaffected

cases.case: Report, artifacts or logs contain key material, a bearer credential, a token-shaped string or an environment-style secret (RP-11 to RP-14)
cases.expect: Detected and failed; the offending value is not echoed in the failure message

cases.case: Diagnostic or JSON output carries a real sandbox ID, owner ID or raw provider error
cases.expect: Output shows redacted aliases and fixed reason codes only

cases.case: Provider metadata is hostile: oversized, deeply nested, or carrying control characters
cases.expect: Output stays bounded and clean

cases.case: Export is asked to include credentials, cookies, provider secrets or private keys, or the source record contains them
cases.expect: Never exported; the export is labelled task evidence, not a familiar backup

cases.case: Qualification evidence packet is assembled for a public issue
cases.expect: Contains revisions, hashes, commands and results; no real sandbox identifier, transcript, private source or private artifact

cases.case: Guest configuration is inspected after credential staging
cases.expect: No provider, admin, signing or database credential present; any harness credential is attempt-scoped

cases.case: Second task submitted while the first attempt's cleanup fence is held
cases.expect: Refused; no credential staged; workspace marker intact

cases.case: A detached descendant of the first attempt survives, or a cleanup step fails
cases.expect: Stays cleanup-required; task two is blocked; workspace data preserved

cases.case: Provider session and credential file are both gone, with no containment evidence
cases.expect: Still refused; absence alone is not containment

cases.case: A flag, environment variable, retry count or test helper is used to get past the refusal
cases.expect: No such path exists; refusal is not convertible into admission

cases.case: Client surface is searched for delete, recreate, reset, resize, stop or start
cases.expect: No destructive verb is reachable; an old checkpoint cannot restore revoked grants or consumed approvals

cases.case: Qualification run ends with cleanup_required retained
cases.expect: Reported as blocked in the matrix; never waived, skipped silently or relabelled as passed

cases.case: Second task succeeds on the same sandbox after real containment evidence
cases.expect: Positive case. Not achievable today: no workspace-preserving containment exists upstream
